name: Fit-only D9b episode-blocked data-scaling curve
purpose: separate response-data limitation from snapshot-representation limitation without reusing the inspected 38-group diagnostic split
scope: the 218 prior fit groups only; prior held-out TRAIN, DEV, and TEST remain closed

data.fold_rule: eligible episode ids sorted numerically and assigned round-robin by index modulo five
data.nested_subset_rule: within each fold order eligible training episodes by SHA256('d9b-scaling-v1:<fold>:<episode>') and take ceil(fraction times episode count); subsets are nested
data.normalization: per fold, fit normalization on neighborhood rows from every eligible non-validation episode; hold fixed across fractions

model.architecture: unchanged D9b raw temporal pair encoder, six-level context, shared ReLU group amplitude and per-level softplus shapes
model.target: continuous task-free shared amplitude and normalized 6-by-41 response shape

optimization.sampling: deterministic uniform group sampling without replacement; no class balancing
optimization.execution: one sequential GPU run at a time

reporting.primary: pooled per-group 6-by-41 log-response MSE across the five excluded folds

interpretation.replicated_clear_scaling: prioritize broader task-agnostic contact-response collection with a new untouched validation split
interpretation.pilot_gate_fails_or_replicated_gain_belo: snapshot state plus action representation is the primary suspect; test generic temporal/contact history
interpretation.intermediate: run a small data-by-history factorial study
